props.html: FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions

items.a: Webfiver offers website development, custom trading tools, ATS-friendly resume writing, content writing, LinkedIn profile revamping, LinkedIn management, and online courses in digital marketing, AI, English speaking, and content writing.

items.q: How much does it cost to build a website with Webfiver?
items.a: Website development at Webfiver starts at ₹4,999 for a basic website. Business websites start at ₹11,999, while custom web applications start at ₹24,999. Final prices depend on project requirements.

items.q: Can Webfiver build custom trading tools?
items.a: Yes. Webfiver can develop custom trading dashboards, stock scanners, options chain analysis tools, trading calculators, and Pine Script indicators based on the agreed requirements and available data sources.
Yes. Webfiver offers resume creation, resume redesign, keyword optimization, and job-description alignment to help candidates present their qualifications clearly in recruiter-friendly formats.

items.q: What is a LinkedIn profile revamp?
items.a: A LinkedIn profile revamp improves your headline, About section, experience descriptions, skills, and relevant keywords to communicate your professional value more effectively.
Webfiver offers LinkedIn content planning, post writing, publishing coordination, and profile positioning support. Exact deliverables depend on the selected package.

items.q: Which online courses does Webfiver offer?
items.a: The proposed course categories include digital marketing, AI tools, English speaking and communication, and content writing. Course availability, syllabus, and enrollment details should be confirmed on the relevant course page.

items.q: Are Webfiver’s services suitable for beginners?
items.a: Yes. Beginners, freelancers, job seekers, creators, and businesses can discuss their requirements and choose a suitable service or course.
You can contact Kalpesh Goswami through the website’s contact form, email, or WhatsApp once those contact details are added. Share your requirements to receive a suitable proposal.

items.q: Does Webfiver guarantee Google rankings, jobs, or trading profits?
items.a: No. SEO results, hiring outcomes, and financial market results cannot be guaranteed. Webfiver focuses on delivering the agreed services and tools without promising specific external outcomes.
